Fuzz target for snapshot tar parsing with custom input generation and parser advancement.

# Purpose
This file defines a fuzzing harness for `fd_ssparse`, the snapshot parser. It contains [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>), [`LLVMFuzzerCustomMutator`](<#llvmfuzzercustommutator>), and [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>), so it is meant to be used with libFuzzer. The initialization code starts the `fd` runtime, sets log levels, disables backtraces, and allocates parser memory with `aligned_alloc` for repeated test runs.

The custom mutator builds input data that matches the parser format. It creates an account vector map at the start of the buffer, then appends TAR-like snapshot content such as `version`, `snapshots/status_cache`, `snapshots/123`, account files, random structured data, and garbage. Helper functions such as [`make_tar_hdr`](<#make_tar_hdr>), [`add_snapshot_chunk`](<#add_snapshot_chunk>), [`make_version`](<#make_version>), and [`add_garbage`](<#add_garbage>) write valid or invalid TAR headers, file data, and padding. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) reads the generated account vector map, loads it into `fd_ssparse` with `fd_ssparse_populate_acc_vec_map`, then feeds the remaining input to `fd_ssparse_advance` until the parser reports done or error.
